descriptions.fast: Lowest latency, good for simple queries
descriptions.reasoning: Better for complex logic and multi-step thinking
descriptions.code: Optimized for programming tasks and debugging

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.welcomeHtml: Welcome to Manna — a local-first AI agent platform. Use the sidebar to access different tools: Chat for conversations, Agent for autonomous task execution, Swarm for multi-agent complex tasks, Code Tools for IDE features, and Upload for file analysis.

agent.title: Agent Task
agent.subtitle: Give the agent a natural-language task. It will reason step-by-step, pick tools from its registry, and execute them autonomously (up to 5 iterations).
agent.taskPlaceholder: Describe what you want the agent to do…
agent.taskHint: Be specific: e.g. ‘Read package.json and summarise all dependencies’ or ‘Search the web for Vue 3 best practices’.
agent.profileHint: Auto lets Manna’s router pick the best model per step. Fast = low latency, Reasoning = complex tasks, Code = programming tasks.
agent.runTaskTooltip: Sends the task and waits for the complete result (no intermediate updates).
agent.streamTooltip: Sends the task and shows real-time events as the agent reasons and uses tools.
agent.liveEventsSubtitle: Each event shows one step in the agent’s reasoning chain: tool calls, model routing decisions, and completion.
agent.noTasksYet: No tasks yet. Submit your first task!

chat.startNewConversationHint: Select a routing profile and click + to create one. Conversations are read-only — use Agent Task or Code Chat if you need file writes.
chat.persistedHint: Messages are persisted on the backend. Use “Run with agent” to get AI responses.
chat.noMessagesYet: No messages yet — type one below.
chat.inputPlaceholder: Type a message… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline)
chat.deleteConversationConfirm: Delete this conversation and all its messages?

codeTools.title: Code Tools
codeTools.subtitle: Direct IDE endpoints — fast, single-purpose code intelligence. These bypass the agent loop for lower latency, calling specialised models directly.
codeTools.languageHint: Helps the model produce syntax-correct completions for your language.
codeTools.codePrefixHint: The code before your cursor position. The model continues writing from here.
codeTools.codeSuffixHint: The code after your cursor. Enables fill-in-the-middle (FIM) mode for better context-aware completions.
codeTools.completionTooltip: Round-trip time including model inference. Powered by a fast code-specialised model.
codeTools.includeLlmTooltip: When off, only deterministic TypeScript/convention rules run (fastest). When on, an AI model also reviews the code for style, bugs, and best practices.
codeTools.maxFindingsHint: Cap the number of reported issues. Useful for large files.
codeTools.projectContextHint: Describe your project briefly (e.g. ‘Vue 3 SPA with Pinia stores’) so the reviewer gives more relevant, targeted suggestions.

swarm.title: Swarm Orchestration
swarm.subtitle: Swarm decomposes a complex task into subtasks, runs them in parallel across multiple agents, then synthesises a final answer. Best for multi-part research or analysis tasks.
swarm.taskPlaceholder: Describe a complex task to decompose across multiple agents…
swarm.taskHint: Works best with complex, multi-part tasks: e.g. ‘Research Vue 3, React, and Svelte — compare performance, DX, and ecosystem size’.
swarm.maxSubtasksHint: Limits how many subtasks are created. Leave empty to let the system decide. Lower = faster but less thorough.
swarm.runSwarmTooltip: Waits for all subtasks to complete, then returns the full result with per-subtask breakdowns.
swarm.runSwarmStreamTooltip: Shows live events as subtasks start, complete, and the final synthesis happens.
swarm.subtaskBreakdownSubtitle: Each subtask ran independently with its own agent loop. Expand a row to see the individual answer.
swarm.noSwarmYet: No swarm tasks yet. Submit your first task!

workflow.title: Workflow Orchestration
workflow.noWorkflowsYet: No workflows yet. Submit your first workflow!
workflow.subtitle: Define a list of sequential steps, each executed by a dedicated agent. The output of each step can optionally be passed to the next via context carry.
workflow.contextCarryHint: Controls what context flows into each step: Summary condenses prior output, Full passes the complete text, None starts fresh each step.
workflow.maxStepsPerStepHint: Maximum agent iterations per step. Leave empty to use the server default. Raise only if a step requires many tool calls.

upload.title: Upload & Analyze
upload.subtitle: Upload files for AI-powered analysis: classify images with a vision model, transcribe audio with Whisper, or extract text from PDFs (fast and deterministic).
upload.imageDropLabel: Drop an image here or click to browse
upload.imageDropHint: PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF — max 50 MB
upload.customPromptHint: Override the default prompt. E.g. ‘Describe all text visible in this image’ or ‘Is this a cat or a dog?’.
upload.imageModelHint: Leave empty to use the default vision model. Specify an Ollama multimodal model name to override (e.g. llava:13b).
upload.audioDropLabel: Drop an audio file here or click to browse
upload.audioDropHint: WAV, MP3, OGG, etc. — max 50 MB
upload.languageHintDesc: ISO 639-1 code (e.g. ‘en’, ‘it’, ‘de’). Helps Whisper produce more accurate transcriptions.
upload.contextPromptHint: Provide domain-specific vocabulary or context to improve accuracy (e.g. technical terms, proper nouns).
upload.pdfDropLabel: Drop a PDF file here or click to browse
upload.pdfDropHint: PDF files — max 50 MB. Text is extracted without AI — fast and deterministic.

systemInfo.title: System Info
systemInfo.routingProfilesSubtitle: Each profile maps to a specific Ollama model optimised for different workloads. The model router automatically selects the best profile per agent step, or you can force one manually in Agent / Swarm views.
systemInfo.noRoutingProfiles: No routing profiles loaded. Click refresh to fetch.
systemInfo.ollamaModelsSubtitle: All models currently loaded in the local Ollama instance. These are the actual LLMs available for inference.
systemInfo.noOllamaModels: No Ollama models loaded. Click refresh to fetch.
systemInfo.apiReferenceSubtitle: Complete list of backend HTTP endpoints. Use this as a reference for direct API integration.
systemInfo.apiNotLoaded: API reference not loaded. Click refresh to fetch.

settings.title: Settings
settings.apiUrlHint: The HTTP address of your Manna backend server. Default: http://localhost:3001. Change this if running Manna on a different host or port.
settings.workspaceRootHint: Absolute path inside the Manna container where your project is mounted (e.g. /workspace/my-project). Set this once and it will be forwarded automatically to all agent calls.
settings.defaultModelProfileHint: Pre-selects this profile across all views. 'Auto' lets Manna's model router choose the best model per request.
settings.aboutText: Manna is a local-first AI agent platform.
settings.aboutSubtext: No authentication required. All data is stored in-memory on the frontend (localStorage for settings only). The backend is stateless between restarts — conversation history lives in this browser tab only.

error.notFoundDesc: The page you are looking for does not exist.
error.serverErrorDesc: Something went wrong on the server.

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: Manage PDF knowledge bases: list libraries, import archives, run semantic search, and export article metadata.
library.noLibraries: No libraries returned by the backend.
library.searchResult: 0 search results | 1 search result | {n} search results
library.exportResult: 0 exported articles | 1 exported article | {n} exported articles

codeChat.title: Code Chat
codeChat.subtitle: Chat with your codebase using the code-profile agent. Set a workspace root in Settings so the agent can access your mounted project files.
codeChat.noWorkspace: No workspace root configured. The agent will not be able to read project files.
codeChat.taskPlaceholder: e.g. Explain the authentication flow, or Refactor the payment module…
codeChat.taskHint: The workspace path is automatically forwarded to the backend. The agent can read and write files inside the workspace.
codeChat.noHistoryYet: No questions yet. Ask something about your code!

codeIndex.title: Code Index
codeIndex.subtitle: Analyse your project structure with the agent. The agent reads files from the mounted workspace and produces a structured overview.
codeIndex.noWorkspace: No workspace root configured. Set one in Settings before running analysis.
codeIndex.analyzeDesc: Choose an analysis mode and click Analyse. The agent will explore the workspace and return a structured report.
codeIndex.analysisModeHint: Controls the depth and focus of the analysis.
codeIndex.howItWorksDesc: The analysis uses the existing agent with the code profile. No dedicated indexing endpoint is required.
codeIndex.step1: Agent reads files from the mounted workspace
codeIndex.step2: Agent builds a structured overview based on the analysis mode
codeIndex.step3: Result is displayed here and saved to session history
codeIndex.phase5Note: Phase 5: A dedicated /code/index endpoint will enable persistent symbol-level indexing and semantic code search. This view is the frontend scaffolding for that future capability.

observability.title: Activity History
observability.subtitle: Persistent log of all backend lifecycle events — agent steps, tool calls, routing decisions, swarm activity, and more.
observability.noEntriesHint: No history entries yet. Click Refresh to load.

graphBuilder.title: Graph Builder
graphBuilder.subtitle: Build visual pipelines by connecting nodes on the canvas. Right-click the canvas to add nodes, then wire them together and click Execute to run the pipeline on the backend agent.
graphBuilder.nodesHint: Text Input · LLM Generate · Read File · Write File · Shell · Browser Fetch · Semantic Search · Text Output. Right-click the canvas to place any node.
graphBuilder.saveTooltip: Download the current graph as a JSON file you can reload later.
graphBuilder.loadTooltip: Import a previously saved graph JSON file.
graphBuilder.clearTooltip: Remove all nodes and connections from the canvas.
graphBuilder.executeTooltip: Serialise the graph and send it to the agent for execution. Results appear in the panel below.
graphBuilder.noResult: No result yet. Build a graph with nodes and edges, then click Execute to run the pipeline on the backend.
